messages:
lucas: hey team, first-day PR stuck 1 1 buildkite job fails trying to pull from our private package registry and GH won't let me merge because the required check failed. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/412
tess: welcome @lucas! paste the failing log snippet?
lucas: here:
```
Step: npm ci
npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - GET https://packages.redwood.internal/@redwood/core - You do not have access
Error: failed to install dependencies
```
samir: that 401 from the registry usually means the CI token used by the agent doesn't have permission to read that package. are you in the org team that maps to the registry ACL? new hires sometimes miss the auto-join.
lucas: i joined the org invite but didn't get any teams yet. i tried the handbook step about "request access to internal packages" but not sure who to ping.
infra-oncall: @lucas i can check. quick check: which repo pipeline ran (bk job id)?
lucas: buildkite job bk-42042 per the PR UI.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" queued for PR #412 (job id: bk-42042).
infra-oncall: looking at job metadata... runner used pool "ci-us-1" and the pipeline tried to fetch packages using CI_REGISTRY_TOKEN bound to the instance profile. token is fine, but the package ACL blocks users not in team "pkg-readers". lucas isn't in that team.
tess: we should add new hires to pkg-readers automatically but looks like our user-sync missed one during onboarding. i'll add lucas manually for now.
infrastructure-oncall: (typo) oops ignore
infra-oncall: @tess done 1 added @lucas to team pkg-readers. requeueing the job.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" started for PR #412 (job id: bk-42043).
lucas: re-run in progress, thanks.
buildkite-bot: npm ci step succeeded for job bk-42043 ✅
buildkite-bot: pipeline "redwood-ci/main" finished for PR #412 (job id: bk-42043)  passed ✅
merge-bot: merge blocked  required checks failing: github/actions (stale), awaiting re-evaluation.
jen: GH sometimes caches the status; try pushing an empty commit or re-requesting status. @infra-oncall can you trigger a status re-eval?
infra-oncall: requested status re-evaluation via API. should flip within a minute.
merge-bot: merge allowed  all required checks passed.
lucas: merged! thanks everyone 1 excited to get started :tada:
tess: welcome @lucas :tada: i'll add a checklist step to onboarding to confirm pkg-readers team membership and include how to check registry ACL errors.
samir: pro tip for new hires: when you see E401 from packages, include the runner name and bk job id in the ping to #eng-infra, it speeds up triage.
jen: welcome aboard! we'll follow up in the handbook so future misses are caught by the user-sync job.
